governing: ADR-0123 signed-immutable-captures; ADR-0125 capture chronology; ADR-0126 F4 single-surface threat model; Packet 4 Matrix v9 (0089).

entry_points: VerifiedCapture.member / CapturedMemberHandle.read_bytes/read_text / CapturedJsonArtifact.value/audit / CapturedBindings.require (the handle API), and the _LIFECYCLE_VIEWS handle registry
scope.non_goal: durable or cross-process consume-once and reconstruction remain Packet 8; this packet proves in-process equality and fail-closed restart identity only. Signature forgery under the caller-known development _DEV_KEY is ADR-0126-deferred, not closed here.

identity_bindings.binding: freeze_consumer_document requires the descriptor's root_ref/snapshot_version/document_sha256/node/output/purpose to equal the already-PUBLISHED descriptor exactly; a substituted producer/root/member identity refuses.

ConsumerCapturedPort is derived (consumer_document_sha256 = SHA-256 of the frozen consumer document bytes; consumer_node/consumer_input/purpose from the freeze) and never caller-spelled; derive_consumer_port re-hashes and refuses on change.
capture/_prepare_legacy_capture requires port == derive_consumer_port(frozen), the frozen intern to match published, consumer run distinct from producer session run, and the producer session ended.
open_capture/captured_bindings/_consume_binding bind session, bound_session, stream_id, run_identity, and transition_nonce; a session from another run/process/purpose refuses.
open_capture re-checks member_manifest_sha256 and each member sha256/bytes against the sealed digests; a mutated or substituted member refuses.

start_producer_session/end_session carry the producer-session identity that capture_port/session_stream depend on (consumer run distinct from producer session run; producer session must end before capture).

receipts enforce PRODUCED->SEALED->PUBLISHED->CAPTURED->CONSUMED order, exact sequence, and predecessor-hash structural linkage. NOTE: a forged predecessor whose signature validates under the caller-known development _DEV_KEY is ADR-0126-deferred and is NOT closed by this packet; only structural sequence/hash linkage and in-process chain integrity are swept.

descriptor purpose, published descriptor purpose, and subject purpose must match at every seam; freeze_consumer_document compares descriptor purpose to published purpose immediately after published lookup, before frozen handle registration.

one CAPTURED stream yields exactly one CONSUMED; a second consume of the same stream refuses (in-process). The authorization-entry dedupe in authorize_capture_set (commit dedupe, trust.py ~4891) is retained.

cases: two published tokens with equal root_ref but different document_sha256
equal descriptor bytes, different producer run_identity
equal root_ref/snapshot_version/document_sha256/node/output but different purpose; caller purpose matches the substituted descriptor and must still refuse against published purpose
substitute published token, frozen document, derived port, sealed member, or a CAPTURED/VerifiedCapture/bindings handle from another stream
a VerifiedCapture/CapturedBindings/CapturedMemberHandle from a DIFFERENT broker instance (cross-broker handle substitution via _LIFECYCLE_VIEWS identity)
retry capture after a refusal with the same nonce
retry with corrected evidence after each staged failure
consumer run_identity equals producer session run
session bound to a different run

a stream_id/session that looks equal after an in-process reload must still refuse if its _stream_pin/receipt-store identity is not exactly the committed lineage; refusal mode is fail-closed (no silent accept, no durability claim here)
one CAPTURED authorization must not become a second CONSUMED authority via a replayed handle, duplicate nonce, or re-derived port
